# eon_resources (Data Source)

Retrieves a filtered list of inventory resources in the Eon project. Use this data source to resolve Eon resource IDs for other resources that require them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Retrieve inventory resources, optionally filtered
data "eon_resources" "aws_ec2" {
  cloud_providers = ["AWS"]
  resource_types  = ["AWS_EC2"]
}

# Example: Resolve a resource ID by provider ID for use in other resources
data "eon_resources" "by_provider_id" {
  provider_resource_ids = ["i-0123456789abcdef0"]
}

output "resolved_resource_id" {
  description = "Eon resource ID resolved from the cloud provider resource ID"
  value       = try(data.eon_resources.by_provider_id.resources[0].id, null)
}

output "aws_ec2_resources" {
  description = "AWS EC2 inventory resources in the project"
  value       = data.eon_resources.aws_ec2.resources
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud_providers` (List of String) Filter to resources whose cloud providers are in this list. Possible values: `AWS`, `AZURE`, `GCP`.
- `environments` (List of String) Filter to resources whose environments are in this list. Possible values: `PROD`, `PROD_INTERNAL`, `STAGE`, `ENVIRONMENT_UNSPECIFIED`.
- `ids` (List of String) Filter to resources whose Eon-assigned IDs are in this list.
- `provider_account_ids` (List of String) Filter to resources whose cloud-provider-assigned account IDs are in this list.
- `provider_resource_ids` (List of String) Filter to resources whose cloud-provider-assigned IDs are in this list.
- `resource_names` (List of String) Filter to resources whose display names are in this list.
- `resource_types` (List of String) Filter to resources whose types are in this list. Possible values include `AWS_EC2`, `AWS_S3`, `AWS_RDS`, `AWS_EBS`, `AZURE_VM`, `GCP_COMPUTE_INSTANCE`, and other Eon resource types.

### Read-Only

- `resources` (Attributes List) List of matching inventory resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `backup_status` (String) Backup status of the resource.
- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider. Possible values: `AWS`, `AZURE`, `GCP`.
- `id` (String) Eon-assigned resource ID.
- `provider_account_id` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned account ID.
- `provider_resource_id` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned resource ID.
- `region` (String) Region the resource is hosted in.
- `resource_name` (String) Resource display name.
- `resource_type` (String) Resource type, for example `AWS_EC2` or `AWS_S3`.
